scripts.build: pnpm --filter @public-patterns/web build && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/pipeline build && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/investigator build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @public-patterns/web check && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/pipeline check && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/investigator check
scripts.eval:clustering: uv run experiments/clustering/test_cluster.py && uv run experiments/clustering/evaluate.py --baseline experiments/clustering/fixtures/*.json
scripts.test: node --test experiments/investigator/evaluate.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/pipeline test && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/pipeline test:integration && pnpm --filter @public-patterns/investigator test
